items.q: What is the fee for the beautician course in Belagavi?
items.a: The 30-day Professional Beautician Course at Master Beauty Academy Belagavi is ₹40,000 — flat and all-inclusive, covering all 9 categories from threading to advanced hair treatments. Interest-free EMI plans across 2 or 3 months are available.

items.q: Where is your Belagavi centre located?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy Belagavi is at S N Pride Complex, Gondhali Galli, above New Takkekar Eye Hospital, Khade Bazar, Raviwar Peth, Belagavi — 590001. Easily reachable from Raviwar Peth, Tilakwadi, and a short auto ride from the Central Bus Stand.

items.q: Which is the best beauty academy in Belagavi?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy is Belagavi's award-winning beauty institute — co-founded by Priyanka Sakhe (LAPT London, Global Fame Awards 2023). Over 1,000 women across North Karnataka have trained here, many now earning up to ₹1 lakh per month from their own salons.

items.q: What are the batch timings at Belagavi?
items.a: Morning and evening batches run Monday to Saturday at the Belagavi centre. Call or WhatsApp our counsellor for the next intake start date — new batches open regularly.

items.q: Do you offer placement after the Belagavi course?
items.a: Yes. Belagavi graduates are placed across partner salons in Belagavi, Hubli and broader Karnataka. Placement support includes interview prep, portfolio building, and direct salon-owner introductions.
